card.hover: translateY(-3px), shadow-md feel, gold-300 border emphasis

modalAndDrawer.feel: direct and restrained; no dramatic travel or delayed content

reducedMotion.intent: disable non-essential transforms/reveals while preserving immediate state change and usability

neverAnimate: content in a way that delays access

mayChooseWithoutDesignApproval: CSS versus JS for equivalent observable feel
safe implementation that prevents permanently hidden content
mustReportBeforeBroadApplication: preventing or replacing default browser scroll behavior across routes
site-wide scroll/provider engine or equivalent global behavior surface
mechanismBoundary.rule: Claude may change technical mechanism without approval only when visible FEEL and observable behavior remain unchanged and no material global behavior surface is introduced.
